title: A rejection records a structured class in the run checkpoint (ticfac bundle 1.1.0)
description: Deferred from #117/#120 (2026-09-28): resume classifies a rejected attempt with no disposition by matching phrases in the checkpoint's prose reason (#117). Rewording a message would silently stop classification (fails safe to the hold). Add a structured rejection class to the run-state checkpoint written at rejection time, and read it first; keep the phrase classifier only for legacy checkpoints. Blocked on 4i8 (ticfac owns its contracts) landing on main with epic 6in: until then contracts/ticfac-run-state.json is pinned to ticks and verified byte for byte.
acceptance_criteria: The checkpoint carries a rejection class (bundle 1.1.0, contract tests updated); resume reads it before the phrase fallback; a test rewords a rejection message and resume still classifies it
